hero.title: Faster claims, smarter decisions, lower costs
hero.summary:
Every claim assessed against the policy, every invoice benchmarked, every damage report prepared.

Accurate, explainable outcomes in minutes.

scene.title: Water damage claim

claimsDecisioning.title: Claims settled in minutes, not weeks
claimsDecisioning.text: Every line is checked against the policy wording, the amount calculated and the reason written down, ready for your adjuster to confirm.

invoiceBenchmarking.title: Never overpay on an invoice again
invoiceBenchmarking.text: Every invoice, quote and estimate is benchmarked line by line, with a reissue request drafted for every line that is too high.

damageReporting.title: Complete damage reports, prepared for you
damageReporting.text: Photographs and documents become a priced estimate and a full scope of work at first notification, before anyone visits the site.

logos.zhaw: ZHAW Zurich University of Applied Sciences

compliance.heading: Compliant by design
paragraphs: Every decision maps to the clause it rests on, the evidence it used and the person who made it. Your auditors, your regulator and your customers can request the full audit trail at the click of a button.
True Aim sits alongside the systems you already run. Your data stays yours, and so do your rules, limits and thresholds.
compliance.imageAlt: A metal lock carrying the True Aim symbol
